meta.text: Option B is an autoscaling job cluster on a current LTS runtime with spot workers and Photon enabled. This gives you the lowest cost per DBU, scales with the actual data volume, and is isolated per run — the cluster spins up for the job and terminates when it ends. The one catch is spot reclamation, so you need a retry policy to re-run interrupted tasks. Keep that in mind; it's the trade-off this option buys.
